title: Enum source
description: Meta-schema for data/enums/*.yaml. Each file declares a typed enum: a `meta` block describing the C++/Lua surface, and a `values` map of name -> integer.

flags.description: True if values are bitmask flags.

underlying.description: C++ underlying integer type for the enum class.

case.description: Case style for generated enum value names. `pascal` (default): `War`, `MysteryBox`. `screaming`: `WAR`, `MYSTERY_BOX`.

none.description: Adds a C++-only `None = 0` member, so a default-initialised value has a name. Data and Lua can't use it.

collect.description: Members taken from data files spread over many folders, such as one file per zone. Each entry of the section is a member named by its key. Module copies under `modules/*/data/` add to it.

section.description: Dotted path to the section holding the entries in each file.

index.description: With `zone_bits`: the entry field holding its index within the zone.

zone_bits.description: A member's value is the zone id of the folder the file sits in, shifted up this many bits, ORed with the entry's `index`. Without it, the value is the entry's `id`.

table.description: Lua table path the values are exported under. Example: `xi.itemFlag`, or nested like `xi.automaton.head`.

values.description: Map of value name -> integer. Names must be snake_case and unique. Integers may be decimal or hex (0xNN).
